clue.text: The last word in PR ruling presents a dilemma

parts.note: taken as written, the abbreviation for public relations

indicators.note: the clue says one piece sits in the other, so the last word goes inside the PR ruling

parts.note: an edict is an official ruling or decree
amen is the word said at the end of a prayer, literally the last word

explanation.surface: A public-relations decision on the final say leaves everyone in a quandary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The last word' reads like a final verdict, but it is the word that closes a prayer; 'in' puts it inside the PR ruling, before the ruling's final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name an awkward situation with no easy way out, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Sent to a prison store

definitions.meaning: to put someone away is to jail them
to put something away is to keep it for later use

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both jailed someone and stowed goods for later.

clue.text: Set up before going to Connecticut

parts.note: ere is an old poetic word for before
CT is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Connecticut

explanation.surface: Something gets built before the traveller heads off to Connecticut.
explanation.definitionFit: To build or raise a structure is to set it up.

clue.text: Resident taken around an island without life

indicators.note: the resident is wrapped around the other pieces, so they sit inside it

parts.note: an inmate is a resident of an institution such as a prison or asylum
taken as written
I is a standard abbreviation for island on maps

explanation.surface: A local is shown round an island that has no living things on it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inanimate has no life or animation, like a stone.

clue.text: How land looks in the Kalahari Desert

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words Kalahari Desert, running across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A geography question about the appearance of the Kalahari's terrain.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry, parched land with no rain is described as arid, as in a desert.

clue.text: Appeal for admittance when about to dine

indicators.note: the word for admittance is placed about, that is around, the word for dine

parts.note: entry means admission or admittance to a place
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: Someone pleads to be let into a restaurant just as they are about to have dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest plea or request.

clue.text: Follow the band

definitions.meaning: a band is one recorded section on a vinyl record, a single song

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for trailing someone and a noun for one song on an album, once called a band on an LP.

clue.text: French wine and English fish need a condiment

parts.note: vin is the French word for wine
the gar is a long-snouted freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A recipe in which French wine and an English fish want something to season them.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegar is a sour liquid used to flavour or preserve food, a classic condiment.

clue.text: Mechanical cutter hotel group looked at

parts.note: a chain is a group of hotels under one owner
saw is the past tense of see, so looked at

explanation.surface: Inspectors from a hotel company examined a piece of cutting machinery.
explanation.definitionFit: A powered saw with teeth on a moving loop is a mechanical tool for cutting wood.

clue.text: If treatment fails, he gets the blame first

definitions.text: If treatment fails, he gets the blame first

parts.note: taken as written
to take the rap is to take the blame
1st, written IST in crosswords, is first

explanation.surface: When a course of treatment fails, the practitioner is blamed before anyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes who gets blamed when a course of counselling goes wrong; 1ST appears as IST, a common crossword spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A counsellor who treats patients is the person blamed when the treatment does not work.

clue.text: White woman in a new environment

indicators.note: the woman is placed in the other letters, which form her environment

parts.note: taken as written
she is the pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A woman goes pale on finding herself somewhere unfamiliar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'environment' says that A and N surround the woman.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashen face is pale grey or white with shock.

clue.text: Having sex appeal is trendy

parts.note: with means having, as in a man with a hat
it is an old slang term for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Being sexually attractive is fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is old slang for being fashionable and up to date.

clue.text: Goodness me! Heather is challenging the speaker

parts.note: heck is a mild exclamation of surprise
ling is another name for common heather

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in surprise that Heather is interrupting the person talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name but it is the plant, LING.
explanation.definitionFit: Barracking a public speaker with rude interruptions is heckling.

clue.text: Smallholder from the former Arab sultanate

parts.note: ye is an archaic spelling of the, as in Ye Olde Shoppe
Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A farmer who comes from a sultanate that no longer exists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'former' looks as if it goes with the sultanate, but it belongs to 'the', giving the archaic YE; Oman is still a sultanate.
explanation.definitionFit: A yeoman was a man who farmed his own small holding of land.

clue.text: I appear in another novel broadcast

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone boasts they feature in another book that is being broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book; it signals that I and ANOTHER are rearranged together.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme being transmitted on radio or television is said to be live, going out at that moment.

clue.text: A penny-pincher about to acquire a spray

indicators.note: the miser is put about, that is around, the word to

parts.note: taken as written
a miser is a stingy penny-pincher
taken as written

explanation.surface: A stingy person is on the point of buying a spray.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that turns liquid such as perfume into a fine mist is a spray.

clue.text: Libertine gets swallowed by swamp in Morocco

definitions.note: the definition names a place found in Morocco, a city there

indicators.note: the libertine is engulfed by the swamp, so he goes inside it

parts.note: a marsh is a swamp
a rake is a dissolute man, a libertine

explanation.surface: A rogue disappears into a bog while travelling in North Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Marrakesh is a major city of Morocco, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: Lanky chap taken by old airline to the Arctic

parts.note: BEA was British European Airways, a former British airline
the North Pole, N Pole, is at the centre of the Arctic

explanation.surface: A tall thin man flies to the far north on a defunct carrier.
explanation.definitionFit: Tall, thin people are compared to the long stick that supports climbing bean plants.

clue.text: Comparatively awful accommodating the indecisive man

indicators.note: accommodating means housing or holding, so one word holds the other inside it

parts.note: dire means awful, so the comparative is direr
taken as written

explanation.surface: An indecisive man is put up in even worse lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who keeps wavering and cannot make up their mind is indecisive.

clue.text: Decline to have a nap

definitions.meaning: a fall or decrease, as in sales

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a noun for a fall in numbers and a verb for nodding off to sleep.

clue.text: Stop the car to get water from a well

definitions.meaning: a vehicle draws up when it pulls in and halts

definitions.text: to get water from a well
definitions.meaning: water is drawn up from a well in a bucket

explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle pulling in and halting does this, and so does a bucket hauled from a well.

clue.text: Caustic chap who makes doubles-entendres

parts.note: a pun is a play on words, a kind of double meaning
gent is short for gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: A sharp-tongued man whose jokes are full of smutty double meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Pungent remarks are sharp and biting, which is what caustic means.

clue.text: Finished! Finished! The steak is finished!

parts.note: over means finished, at an end
done means finished, completed

explanation.surface: An exasperated chef shouts that the steak is ready, three times over.
explanation.walkthrough: The third 'finished' is the cooking sense: a steak cooked too long.
explanation.definitionFit: A steak cooked for too long, past the point it should have been, is described as overcooked.

clue.text: Prepare the bird from habit

definitions.meaning: to ... a chicken or game bird is to clean it ready for cooking
a habit is a garment, such as a nun's robe

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means readying poultry for the oven, and the noun is a garment like a monk's habit.

clue.text: Mother meets a Scotsman who epitomises wealth

parts.note: mam is an informal word for mother
mon is a Scottish dialect form of man

explanation.surface: A mother is introduced to a man from Scotland who is very rich.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible Mammon is riches personified as a false god, the embodiment of greed for money.

clue.text: Spies French friend in American resort

parts.note: MI, from MI5 and MI6, stands for British intelligence services
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: Agents spot a French friend at a US holiday spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Florida city is a famous beach and holiday destination in the US.

clue.text: It goes into a collar for valuable horses

definitions.meaning: a small fastener that fixes a detachable shirt collar
a set of horses kept for breeding

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a small button for fixing a shirt collar and a group of horses kept for breeding.

clue.text: Nothing pleasant about being suspended

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
nice means pleasant

explanation.surface: There is nothing nice about being hung up.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan put on ice is postponed or kept in abeyance, temporarily suspended.

clue.text: A note when wrongly modulated is fading away

indicators.note: a note badly modulated is put out of tune, so these letters are changed in order

explanation.surface: A musical note played out of key fades into silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Something declining in strength, like a waning moon, is fading away.

clue.text: Lay out cash with financial caution? Not he!

parts.note: to spend is to lay out money
thrift is careful management of money

explanation.surface: Someone praised for paying out with care is said to be the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not he!' says the person is the opposite of thrifty: a wastrel who spends freely.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasteful person with money is the very opposite of someone who spends with care.
